news.title: Tom Tiffany, Wisconsin Representative, Sustains Minor Injuries After Plane Lands in Lake
news.summary: Representative Tom Tiffany, the Republican nominee for governor, said he and the pilot swam to safety after an emergency landing on Lake Wausau.
